questions.answer:
(ⓒ) It was stupid for me to trust him. → It was stupid of me to trust him.

questions.explanation: 성품 형용사(stupid, generous)는 'of + 목적격', 일반 형용사(useless, impossible)는 'for + 목적격'을 쓴다. 또한 프로젝트가 '완료되는' 것이므로 to be completed 수동태가 필요하다.
acceptedAnswers:
